title: Fence against a wall
hints: Differentiate $A=w(p-2w)$ and set the result to zero.
solution: $A^\prime=[$p]-4w$, which turns from positive to negative at $[$p]/4$. This is the global maximum width, and $A=[$p]^2/8$.

parts.statement:
A rectangle beside a wall uses $[$p]$ m of fencing along three sides. Find the optimal width perpendicular to the wall in meters.
